name: hexyl
description: Modern colorized hex viewer with intelligent byte categorization - distinguishes NULL, ASCII printable, whitespace, and non-ASCII bytes

hexyl.description: Modern command-line hex viewer with colorized output for binary file analysis - written in Rust with high performance and intelligent byte categorization
hexyl.usage:
hexyl firmware.bin # View binary file with colors
hexyl --no-color data.bin # Plain output for scripting
hexyl --raw binary.exe # Compact view without addresses
hexyl --length 1024 large.bin # View first 1KB only
